task.description:
Implement OIDC-08 (Standard claim mapping) per the design at src/design/oidc-08-standard-claim-mapping.md. The design covers:

1. Create src/oidc/claim_mapping.zig with:
   - ClaimMappingConfig struct (realm, tenant_id_claim, roles_claim_paths, email_claim, preferred_username_claim, display_name_claim with defaults)
   - IdentityContext struct (external_user_id, tenant_id optional, roles list, email, preferred_username, display_name optional)
   - loadClaimMappingConfig(allocator, pool, realm) — loads per-realm config from DB, returns null for default
   - mapVerifiedClaims(allocator, config, standard_claims, raw_claims_json) — pure mapping: sub → external_user_id, configurable tenant_id claim, roles via ordered path list, email/preferred_username/name with defaults
   - Missing optional claims produce concrete defaults: email → empty string, preferred_username → sub value, roles → empty list
   - identityContextsEquivalent(a, b) — compare by (external_user_id, realm)
   - resolveJsonPath(document, path) — internal helper for dot-separated path resolution

2. Create migration file for realm_claim_mapping_config table:
   - Columns: id (UUID PK), realm (TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL), tenant_id_claim (TEXT), roles_claim_paths (JSONB), email_claim (TEXT), preferred_username_claim (TEXT), display_name_claim (TEXT), created_at, updated_at

3. Wire into the existing OIDC module structure under src/oidc/ directory

4. Verify: zig build exits 0, zig build test passes, no 'error set' warnings in stderr

5. Ensure all allocating functions accept std.mem.Allocator

6. Commit and push to feature/WF02-oidc08-20260527
acceptance_criteria: zig build exits 0 with no 'error set' warnings in stderr
Migration applies cleanly against fresh DB
All allocating functions accept an allocator parameter
No SQL string interpolation of user data

result.summary: Implemented OIDC-08 standard claim mapping: ClaimMappingConfig, IdentityContext, mapVerifiedClaims (pure), loadClaimMappingConfig (DB), identityContextsEquivalent, resolveJsonPath
result.next_action: Route to TEST-DESIGNER for test specification
